New: debug logs, simpler X button, faster Answer.

- **Debug logs**: Setup screen has a "Debug logs" section. Tap **Send logs** to share a log file of button presses, board reads and errors.
- **X button simplified**: one read, then marks X's over cat colors, rows/columns and the 3x3 around each placed cat. No more self-fix loop, so no more stalls while you keep placing cats.
- **Remove wrong X's** (new setting, off by default): when on, the X button also clears X's sitting on cells where a cat belongs.
- **Answer** places every cat in one pass. The re-check/fix rounds are gone (the game blocks wrong cats anyway).

Install: download **MeowSolver-v2.9.apk** below. Same signing key as v2.7/v2.8, so it installs as an update.
